verified_records.command: id; uname -a; cat /etc/os-release; uptime; date -u; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime

for f in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/compatible /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/chosen/bootargs /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/chosen/stdout-path; do printf "
%s
" "$f"; tr "\000" "
" < "$f"; done; cat /proc/cmdline
lsblk -o NAME,MAJ:MIN,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID,MOUNTPOINT; cat /proc/partitions; cat /proc/mtd; cat /proc/mounts; df -h; fdisk -l /dev/mmcblk1
command -v xmutil xlnx-bootfw xlnx_platformstats xbutil xdputil xclbinutil dtc python3 rpm opkg dnf lsusb v4l2-ctl media-ctl arecord aplay i2cdetect; cat /usr/bin/xmutil; head -n 100 /usr/bin/xdputil
ls -la /boot; find /boot -maxdepth 3 -type f; ls -l /sys/firmware/zynqmp /sys/devices/platform/firmware:zynqmp-firmware
dmesg
systemctl --failed --no-pager -l; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager -l; ps -eo pid,comm

ip -br address; ip route; ip -6 route; cat /sys/class/net/eth0/carrier; networkctl status eth0 --no-pager -l; cat /lib/systemd/network/80-wired.network; cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; journalctl -b -u systemd-networkd -u kria-dashboard.service --no-pager -n 80
xmutil boardid; xmutil bootfw_status

python3 --version; rpm -qa --qf "%{NAME}\t%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\t%{VENDOR}\n" | grep -Ei "vitis|vart|xir|xrt|dpu|zocl|xlnx|dfx|kria|bootfw|xmutil|image-update|fru|kernel|gstreamer|opencv"; find /usr/lib -maxdepth 6 -path "*/xdputil*" -type f; ls -l /usr/lib/libvart* /usr/lib/libxir* /usr/lib/libvitis* /usr/lib/libxrt* /usr/lib/libvaip*
dtc -I fs -O dts /sys/firmware/devicetree/base

xmutil listapps; xbutil examine; for d in /sys/class/fpga_manager/*; do printf "\n%s\n" "$d"; for f in name state status firmware flags; do if test -f "$d/$f"; then printf "%s: " "$f"; cat "$d/$f"; fi; done; done; find /sys/kernel/config/device-tree /configfs/device-tree -maxdepth 3 -type f; ls -l /dev/dri /dev/uio*; ls -l /sys/bus/platform/drivers/zocl /sys/bus/platform/drivers/dpu*; cat /proc/iomem

for d in /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays/*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; ls -l "$d"; cat "$d/status" "$d/path"; done; ls -la /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm /sys/bus/platform/devices/CU.*; for d in /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm; do for f in xclbinuuid kds_custat kds_stat scheduler_stat memstat; do if test -r "$d/$f"; then printf "
%s
" "$d/$f"; cat "$d/$f"; fi; done; done; for d in /sys/class/uio/uio*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; cat "$d/name"; for m in "$d"/maps/map*; do printf "%s " "$m"; cat "$m/name" "$m/addr" "$m/size"; done; done; lsmod; cat /sys/module/zocl/version; modinfo zocl; find /usr/lib /usr/share -maxdepth 5 -iname "*xdputil*"; ls -l /usr/bin/xdputil /usr/bin/xdputil* /usr/bin/xdpu*

lsusb; lsusb -t; ls -l /dev/video* /dev/media* /dev/v4l-subdev* /dev/snd /dev/fb* /dev/dri /dev/i2c-* /dev/spidev* /dev/gpiochip* /dev/pwm*; cat /proc/asound/cards /proc/asound/pcm; arecord -l; aplay -l; v4l2-ctl --list-devices; for d in /sys/class/drm/card*-*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; cat "$d/status" "$d/enabled" "$d/modes"; done; for d in /sys/class/pwm/pwmchip*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; readlink -f "$d/device"; cat "$d/npwm"; ls "$d"; done; ls -l /sys/bus/i2c/devices

cat /usr/lib/python3.9/site-packages/xdputil_component/query.py /usr/lib/python3.9/site-packages/xdputil.py; systemctl cat dpu-auto-config.service dfx-mgr.service; cat /etc/vart.conf /etc/xrt.ini /etc/fstab; printenv XLNX_VART_FIRMWARE XILINX_XRT XCL_EMULATION_MODE; ls -l /usr/bin/*dpu* /usr/share/vitis_ai_library /usr/share/vart /home/root /root /opt; find /lib/firmware/xilinx -maxdepth 3 -type f; find /usr/lib -maxdepth 4 -iname "*dpu*" -o -iname "*xrt*"

for d in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; cat "$d/type" "$d/temp"; done; for d in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; readlink -f "$d/device"; for f in "$d"/name "$d"/temp*_input "$d"/temp*_crit "$d"/temp*_max "$d"/temp*_label "$d"/in*_input "$d"/in*_label "$d"/curr*_input "$d"/curr*_label "$d"/power*_input "$d"/power*_label "$d"/fan*_input; do if test -r "$f"; then printf "%s: " "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done; done; cat /sys/devices/platform/firmware:zynqmp-firmware/last_reset_reason; journalctl -b -p warning --no-pager -n 100

sha256sum /boot/boot.scr /boot/Image /boot/ramdisk.cpio.gz.u-boot /boot/system.dtb /boot/system-zynqmp-sck-kv-g-revB.dtb /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/*; cat /etc/init.d/dpu-auto-config /usr/bin/dpu_auto_config* /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/shell.json; journalctl -b -u dpu-auto-config.service -u dfx-mgr.service --no-pager -n 60; xclbinutil --info --input /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/kv260-benchmark-b4096.xclbin

rpm -V vart xir vitis-ai-library xrt zocl xmutil image-update; rpm -qf /usr/bin/xdputil /usr/lib/python3.9/site-packages/xdputil_component/query.py /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/kv260-benchmark-b4096.bit.bin /lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/kv260-benchmark-b4096.xclbin /usr/share/vitis_ai_library/models; cat /usr/lib/pkgconfig/xrt.pc; cat /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/uevent; ls -la /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm; xbutil examine --help

cat /home/root/dpu_sw_optimize/zynqmp/zynqmp_dpu_optimize.sh; ls -l /home/root/dpu_sw_optimize/zynqmp/functions; cat /etc/init.d/dfx-mgr* /usr/bin/xlnx-firmware-detect; cat /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/xclbinid /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/kds_custat /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/kds_cu_stat; cat /sys/bus/platform/devices/CU.3.auto/name /sys/bus/platform/devices/CU.3.auto/uevent; sha256sum /etc/os-release /etc/vart.conf /etc/fstab /etc/init.d/dpu-auto-config; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

python3 -B -c 'import pathlib,base64,json; p=pathlib.Path("/sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/ip_layout"); b=p.read_bytes(); print(json.dumps({"source":"live ZOCL sysfs IP_LAYOUT","bytes":len(b),"base64":base64.b64encode(b).decode()}))'; cat /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/xclbinid /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/dtbo_path /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/kds_numcus /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/kds_xrt_version; sha256sum /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/xclbin_full; cat /etc/dfx-mgrd/default_firmware; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; dmesg | tail -n 18

ls -l /dev/dpu /dev/dmaproxy*; cat /etc/vart.conf; if test -n "$XCL_EMULATION_MODE"; then printf "XCL_EMULATION_MODE=%s\n" "$XCL_EMULATION_MODE"; else printf "XCL_EMULATION_MODE unset\n"; fi; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /sys/bus/platform/devices/axi:zyxclmm_drm/xclbinid; cat /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays/kv260-benchmark-b4096_image_1/status; cat /sys/class/fpga_manager/fpga0/state
